metadata.title: Request online consultation
metadata.classification_notes: Provides information and access to an online consultation related to the PreDSH preparatory program. Student-facing support entry point, even though it is not a full application workflow.

category_info.purpose: Provides information and access to an online consultation related to the PreDSH preparatory program. Student-facing support entry point, even though it is not a full application workflow.

content.full_text: HTW Berlin - University of Applied Sciences - studies, research, further education International Pathways to HTW Berlin HTW Foundation PreDSH: Preparation for Studies and DSH-Exam Request online consultation Request online consultation Together with HTW Foundation, you will prepare perfectly for your German-language studies and lay a solid foundation for your studies. You will improve your German, train for the DSH-exam for university admission, get to know your future university with its campus and with all the important contact persons, and receive important tips and tricks for studying successfully in Germany.
